11	// reads window.__CONFIG__, which the real app's SSR bootstrap script sets and Storybook never
12	// does — every call site that reads getConfig().app (Zimmermann's own, e.g.
13	// overrides/app/config/contentful.ts, and base SFCC vendor code, e.g. use-auth-modal.js's and
14	// otp-auth/index.jsx's getConfig().app.login) throws in Storybook without this. `login: {}` is
15	// needed alongside `app: {}` — every other getConfig().app.* read in base SFCC guards with `?.`
16	// or `|| {}`, but otp-auth/index.jsx's `const {tokenLength} = getConfig().app.login` does not,
17	// so `.login` itself must already be an object. `sites` is needed for any story whose play
18	// function clicks a button that calls useNavigation() → removeSiteLocaleFromPath() →
19	// getConfigMatcher() → getSites(), which throws when sites is empty. Not a copy of real config
20	// values — just enough shape for vendor code's unguarded reads.
21	if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
22	  (window as typeof window & { __CONFIG__?: { app: Record<string, unknown> } }).__CONFIG__ = {
23	    app: {
24	      login: {},
25	      sites: [
26	        {
27	          id: 'ZimmermannAU',
28	          alias: 'au',
29	          l10n: {supportedLocales: [{id: 'en-AU', alias: 'en-AU'}]},
30	        },
31	      ],
32	    },

36	// ZimmTokensGlobal injects the --zimm-* :root custom properties, mirroring what
37	// _app-config does in the app. Without it, the .zimm-* global classes and the
38	// var(--zimm-*) component overrides (button/header/listMenu) render unresolved in
39	// Storybook. Same shared source as the app, so the two cannot drift.

43	// Futura Round — the fallback measures ~13% wider, so any visual comparison made in
44	// Storybook would not match the app or Figma. Font files are served here by the
45	// staticDirs mapping in .storybook/main.js.

import type { SystemStyleObject } from '@chakra-ui/react';
import { OPACITY_ICON_DISABLED } from 'app/components/ui-kits/zimmCartItemShared';

/** State the component feeds in so the recipe can resolve the value display's dimmed state.
 *  Named `disabled` (not e.g. `isUnavailable`) to match the resolution-prop convention already
 *  used by every other function-form baseStyle in this codebase (zimmTextInput.css.ts's own
 *  `disabled` key) — `theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts`'s PROP_COMBINATIONS harness only
 *  exercises the fixed key set `{inverse, disabled, hasError, focused, filled}`, so a
 *  differently-named boolean here would never have its `true` branch walked by that guard. */
export type ZimmQuantityStepperStyleProps = {
  disabled?: boolean;
};

/**
 * Recipe — cart-line quantity stepper (SFCC-271). Two `ZimmButton variant="icon"` controls sit
 * either side of a numeric value display; all hover/press/focus/disabled states for the buttons
 * themselves live entirely in zimmButton.css.ts (untouched by this file — see index.tsx, which
 * composes ZimmButton rather than restyling it).
 *
 * `root` — the flex row. Gap is 8px (`var(--zimm-scale-xs)` — foundation/spacing.ts's `xs` is
 * `0.5rem`/8px exactly, so this needs no new token). Deliberate, disclosed departure from
 * Figma's own raw annotation, which shows a 12px gap around a bare 12px glyph with no drawn
 * touch target at all. ZimmButton's `icon` size variant already resolves both buttons to a 24px
 * touch target (zimmButton.css.ts `sizes.icon` — `minW`/`minH`: `var(--zimm-scale-xl)`, cited
 * there against WCAG 2.2 AA SC 2.5.8, and matching the Figma node's own literal name
 * `touchTarget` at value 24) — i.e. 6px of invisible padding is already added on every side of
 * each 12px glyph before this gap is even applied. An 8px authored gap between the two 24px
 * button boxes therefore reproduces the ~12px glyph-to-glyph spacing Figma's raw annotation
 * intended (6px inset + 8px gap + 6px inset from centre-of-glyph to centre-of-glyph ≈ the
 * annotated 12px), without shrinking either button below its accessible 24px target — the
 * alternative (an 8px gap measured glyph-edge to glyph-edge with no inset accounted for) would
 * under-space them relative to Figma; this recipe's 8px is the touch-target-aware equivalent,
 * not a straight copy of the raw annotation.
 *
 * `value` — the numeric display. No Figma node or type-style was supplied for this specific text
 * in this build step; `body2Strong` (14px / 500 weight / 18px line-height, typography.ts) is the
 * nearest existing textStyle — PROVISIONAL pending UI-designer confirmation, same disclosure
 * pattern as zimmSizeSelector.css.ts's own oneSize label. Dims to OPACITY_ICON_DISABLED when
 * `disabled` (the whole control is OOS/unavailable, not just one bound) — sourced from
 * zimmCartItemShared.ts rather than restated here or imported from zimmButton.css.ts, so the
 * value display and the two buttons beside it (which get their own dimming entirely from
 * zimmButton.css.ts's `icon` variant, once the caller passes `ariaDisabled` through — nothing
 * about that is duplicated here) can never visually drift apart, without this recipe reaching
 * into an unrelated atom's styling module for the number. Applying the SAME opacity to `root`
 * as well would double it up on the buttons (0.4 × 0.4 = 0.16, not 0.4) — deliberately scoped to
 * `value` only for that reason.
 */
export const ZimmQuantityStepper = {
  parts: ['root', 'value'],
  baseStyle: ({ disabled }: ZimmQuantityStepperStyleProps): Record<string, SystemStyleObject> => ({
    root: {
      display: 'inline-flex',
      alignItems: 'center',
      gap: 'var(--zimm-scale-xs)',
    },
    value: {
      display: 'inline-flex',
      alignItems: 'center',
      justifyContent: 'center',
      textStyle: 'body2Strong',
      color: 'var(--zimm-color-text-default)',
      opacity: disabled ? OPACITY_ICON_DISABLED : 1,
    },
  }),
};

Done. SFCC-271 ZimmQuantityStepper built, standalone, nothing else touched.

## Branch check
`feature/SFCC-11_cart`, clean, 6 commits in — confirmed before writing anything, matches the brief.

## Files (exactly the manifest, nothing else)
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmQuantityStepper/index.tsx` — new
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmQuantityStepper/index.test.tsx` — new
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmQuantityStepper/index.stories.tsx` — new
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmQuantityStepper/zimmQuantityStepper.css.ts` — new
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/zimmCartItemShared.ts` — new
- `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` — modified (Tier 2, pre-authorized): added the `ZimmQuantityStepper` import and registered it in the `components` map, 2 lines, nothing else touched. `git diff --stat` confirms `1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)`. `git status` confirms only these 6 paths are touched anywhere in the tree — `product-item/`, `item-variant/`, `zimmCartDrawer/`, `zimmButton.css.ts`/`zimmButton/index.tsx`, `theme/foundation/` are all untouched.

## What it is
Controlled molecule: `quantity`, `min` (default 1), `max` (required, no default — caller always supplies the real ceiling), `isUnavailable`, `onDecrement(nextQuantity)`, `onIncrement(nextQuantity)`. Composes two `<ZimmButton variant="icon">` (icon="minus"/"plus", both already in `icons/zimm.tsx`) around a `chakra.span` value display. It never mutates quantity itself — only reports the computed next value, matching container/presentational separation since the actual basket-update wiring is explicitly a later commit.

## Evidence per state (all in `index.test.tsx`, 16 tests, real render through real `ChakraProvider`+`app/theme`+real `ZimmButton` — only `ZimmIcon` is mocked, the same leaf-SVG workaround `zimmButton`'s own suite uses, so the ariaDisabled/click-suppression path is genuinely exercised, not assumed)

1. **Qty=1**: `aria-disabled="true"` asserted; separately, `fireEvent.click` + `expect(onDecrement).not.toHaveBeenCalled()` + text still shows "1" — proves the click is a real no-op, not just an attribute check.
2. **Qty=3/max=5**: decrement → `onDecrement` called once, with `2` exactly; increment → `onIncrement` called once, with `4` exactly; neither carries aria-disabled.
3. **Qty=max=5**: increment `aria-disabled="true"`; click → `onIncrement` never called, text stays "5"; decrement stays enabled.
4. **isUnavailable=true, qty=3 (mid-range)**: both buttons `aria-disabled="true"`; clicking both → neither callback fires.
5. **Focus-visible vs default — actual resolved values, not "it passed":** `Button.variants.icon.outline` is `undefined` (no top-level outline in the resting state at all — bg/border/color/transition only); `Button.variants.icon._focusVisible.outline` is `'var(--zimm-focus-ring)'`. The test asserts `focusVisible.outline).not.toBe(icon.outline)` — `'var(--zimm-focus-ring)' !== undefined`, genuinely different, not just structurally separate keys. Also asserted (same describe block): `Button.variants.icon._disabled.opacity === OPACITY_ICON_DISABLED` (0.4) — the same constant this stepper's own recipe reads.
6. Every test above queries `getByRole('button', {name: 'Decrease quantity'/'Increase quantity'})` — if either aria-label were missing/wrong every single test would fail to find the button at all, so all 16 passing is itself the proof; a dedicated test makes this explicit too.
7. **Target size**: `Button.sizes.icon.minW`/`minH` both `=== 'var(--zimm-scale-xl)'`; separately, `spacing.xl === '1.5rem'` (`foundation/spacing.ts` line 15) and `1.5 × 16 = 24 ≥ 24`. Read from the theme object, not rendered — matches what the brief asked for.

All 16 pass. Full suite: `npx tsc --noEmit` clean (no output), `npm run test` → **89 files, 1280 tests, all passing**, including `recipeGuards.test.ts` (6/6) and `recipeParts.test.ts` (43/43) picking up the newly-registered recipe with no failures. Also ran `npx eslint` on all 6 touched files: 0 errors; 3 "forbidden non-null-assertion" warnings, each with the required justifying comment, identical in kind to the 2 already accepted in `zimmButton.css.test.ts` today (same pattern: `Button.sizes!.social`/`Button.variants!.icon`, optional-by-type but always-non-null-in-practice). Also ran a real `storybook build` (not just tsc) to confirm the story resolves through the actual webpack/`ccExtensibility` toolchain, not just type-checks — succeeded cleanly.

## `audit:tokens` — the opacity question, as asked
Ran `npm run audit:tokens`: **0 hits in any of my 6 files**, acknowledged or not. Reasoning: the script's only two patterns are `HEX_RE` (`#`-prefixed) and `UNIT_RE` (`\d+(\.\d+)?(rem|em|px)` — a number immediately suffixed with a unit). `OPACITY_ICON_DISABLED = 0.4` is a bare, unitless multiplier — it structurally cannot match either regex, anywhere it's referenced. This isn't a judgment call I'm making alone: `zimmButton.css.ts` lines 8-12 already do exactly this (`OPACITY_ICON_HOVER = 0.6`, `OPACITY_ICON_DISABLED = 0.4`, both bare named constants, **no** provisional/pending/audit-allow marker), which is the precedent I followed. The 8px gap does map cleanly: `--zimm-scale-xs` ⇒ `spacing.xs` ⇒ `0.5rem` (`foundation/spacing.ts` line 11) = 8px exactly, no adjustment needed. `npm run audit:tokens` did find **7 pre-existing unacknowledged violations elsewhere in the repo** — none in my files, none touched by me (see below, this is relevant to you).

## Design decisions I made and am disclosing (not silently buried)
- **`ariaDisabled`, not `disabled`, on both buttons.** The brief said "disabled attribute/aria-disabled" — genuinely either. I picked `ariaDisabled` to match `ZimmButton`'s own documented guidance (`zimmButton/index.tsx` lines 22-32: "Prefer this over disabled for unavailable-but-explainable states... HTML disabled removes it from the accessibility tree entirely"). A stepper bound is exactly that shape (self-evident from the adjacent number), and it means a keyboard/SR user's tab-stop count on a cart line doesn't shift depending on quantity data. I additionally guard the click inside my own handler (`if (decrementInert) return`) rather than relying solely on ZimmButton's suppression, so the "clicking does nothing" contract holds regardless.
- **The value display also dims via my new recipe when `isUnavailable`.** The brief's acceptance criteria only require the two *buttons* to dim (and that's entirely `zimmButton.css.ts`'s own existing, untouched `_disabled.opacity` — nothing new needed there). But the brief also explicitly requires `OPACITY_ICON_DISABLED` to be read by "the recipe," not just tests — and the buttons need nothing from my recipe to dim correctly. The only place left for that requirement to mean something is the value/number: I dim it to the same 0.4 when fully unavailable, so the whole control reads as uniformly inert rather than two dimmed buttons around a still-bright number. Flagging this as my interpretation, not a stated requirement — easy to revert (delete one ternary in `zimmQuantityStepper.css.ts`) if that wasn't the intent.
- **Callbacks carry the computed value** (`onDecrement(quantity - 1)`), not bare signals — matches `ZimmSizeSelector`'s `onSelectionChange(value)` precedent and makes "decrements by exactly 1" directly assertable (`toHaveBeenCalledWith(2)`) rather than inferred from call count alone.
- **`aria-live="polite"` on the value span** — small, free addition, not tested separately, disclosed here in case you'd rather it wasn't there yet.
- **Aria-labels via `react-intl`** (`defineMessages`, ids `zimm_quantity_stepper.decrement`/`.increment`), not hardcoded strings — matches `ZimmSizeChipGroup`/`ZimmSizeSelector`'s precedent for a component's own intrinsic copy on an 11-locale storefront, not `ZimmInputAction`'s plainer pattern.
- **`textStyle: 'body2Strong'` on the value display is a placeholder**, commented as such (mirroring `zimmSizeSelector.css.ts`'s own disclosed-placeholder style) — no Figma node/type-style was given for this specific text in this step, so I didn't invent a fontSize, I picked the nearest existing named style and said so.

## Unverified gaps (mine)
- The Storybook `play` function (increment/decrement/qty-1-boundary, on the `AtMinimum`/`Default` stories) is **not executed by any test runner** — `vitest.config.ts` only includes `*.test.ts(x)`, and this repo has no `test-storybook`/addon-vitest wiring. I confirmed it type-checks and that a real `storybook build` resolves it, and its assertions mirror logic already proven by the 16 passing Vitest tests against the same real component — but I have not watched it actually run inside Storybook.
- The Figma specifics cited in the brief (raw 12px gap around a bare 12px glyph, node literally named `touchTarget`=24) came from the brief itself — I did not independently re-query Figma to verify those two facts this session. What I *did* independently verify against real code: `zimmButton.css.ts`'s actual 24px resolved touch target, and `spacing.xs` actually being 8px.

## What you're missing
`npm run audit:tokens` turned up 7 unacknowledged raw px literals repo-wide — 5 are old/unrelated, but **2 are inside `item-variant/item-image.tsx` (lines 86, 104) and `item-variant/item-price.tsx` (line 61)**, and `git log` on those exact files shows they landed in **SFCC-270, two commits before this one** — i.e. inside this same cart bundle, not legacy debt. `fontSize="10px"` and `fontSize={{base:'12px', lg:'14px'}}` should be `var(--zimm-font-size-*)`/textStyle. Nothing currently fails because of it (the script isn't CI-wired), so it'll ship silently unless someone deliberately runs the audit — worth a cleanup commit before this bundle merges, since it's still fresh enough that whoever wrote it will remember the intended values.
